# Mailu interface previews

Downloaded on 2026-10-15 from the official Mailu repository. These are unmodified screenshots included in the documentation for the stable 2024.06 branch. They illustrate the administration interface, not the webmail inbox. The documentation still publishes these screenshots; their capture date is not stated.
